title: Formal phrases: a través de, por medio de, mediante

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *mediante* ("by means of") from B1 Unit 24. It is a formal prepositional phrase of means, and a noun follows it directly. Here you use similar phrases to say how people travelled and settled: *a través de* ("through") and *por medio de* ("by means of").

items.spanish: Muchos conseguían información sobre el trabajo a través de cartas de familiares y amigos.
items.english: Many got information about work through letters from relatives and friends.

items.spanish: El gobierno pagaba el pasaje por medio de programas especiales.
items.english: The government paid the passage by means of special programmes.

items.spanish: Mediante su trabajo y sus negocios, los inmigrantes cambiaron la comida y la música.
items.english: Through their work and their businesses, the immigrants changed the food and the music.

sections.content: *A través de* and *por medio de* end in *de*, and then a noun follows: *a través de cartas*, *por medio de programas*. Do not drop the *de* (not *a través cartas*). *Mediante* needs no *de*.
